{{Top|leg}}
The '''Planetary Trade Directorate''' was an organization established by the [[Rhamalian]]s as they began to think about global issues as the population of [[Rhamalai]] grew. The Planetary Trade Directorate was set up to oversee fair trade and barter between the populace as the basis of a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] economy. [[Planetary Trade Director]] [[Markren Pellias]] oversaw the organization.<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref>
